children: Overview
US enterprise technology firm's fiscal Q3 revenue rose 34% yr/yr, beating analyst expectations
Adjusted EPS for fiscal Q3 exceeded company's outlook range
Company raised full-year and FY27 revenue and EPS outlooks on strong demand
Outlook
HPE sees Q4 revenue between $13.9 bln and $14.8 bln
HPE raises FY26 revenue growth outlook to 34%-37% and non-GAAP EPS to $3.75-$3.85
HPE raises FY27 revenue growth outlook to 13%-17% and free cash flow to at least $5.0 bln
Result Drivers
AI DEMAND - Co said surging customer demand for AI solutions was a key growth driver across its portfolio
NETWORKING SEGMENT GROWTH - Networking revenue rose 74.9% yr/yr, with strong gains in Routing and Data Center Networking
MARGIN EXPANSION - Gross and operating profit margins increased sharply, reflecting higher revenue and what management called disciplined execution
